parameters.index: scipy.spatial.cKDTree on ECEF coordinates, reused from the candidate-pair search
parameters.separation: great-circle length recovered from the ECEF chord
parameters.one_to_one: greedy by increasing distance within each UTC date, dates in calendar order, with a lock that persists across dates
parameters.assignment_subset: Hungarian assignment on at most 80 reference rows and 120 partners

processing_level: NOAA-20 and NOAA-21 processing level is unresolved. The local filenames use fire_archive, while the FIRMS download readme says standard-quality data are not yet available for those sensors. The version column is not used as a processing stream.
